description: Renumbered 100773; served 416 Squadron at CFB Chatham and 425 Squadron at Bagotville, became instructional airframe 814B in 1968 and was stored at CFD Mountain View from 1980 with 966 airframe hours. Preserved at CFB Trenton until it came to 5 CDSB Gagetown in 2011 and is stored in the 403 Squadron lines rather than displayed.
museum_name: New Brunswick Military History Museum, 5 CDSB Gagetown

description: Ex-USAF 57-0384, flew with 416 Squadron 1975-1982, became instructional airframe 817B in May 1983 and was struck off strength on 12 February 1990. Displayed at the Air Cadet Training Centre at CFB Trenton before coming to 5 CDSB Gagetown in 2011, where it is disassembled and stored with 403 Squadron.
museum_name: New Brunswick Military History Museum, 5 CDSB Gagetown

description: Wreckage only: the vertical fin and main landing gear recovered from the 1 August 1956 crash site on the base, where Flight Lieutenant Ian Gordon-Johnson, an RAF exchange officer flying from the OTU at RCAF Station Chatham, was killed.
museum_name: New Brunswick Military History Museum, 5 CDSB Gagetown
